name: Logos Vision
what_they_do: Optometry practice and luxury eyewear boutique run by Dr. Silvana Abadeer, OD, offering comprehensive eye exams, dry eye treatment (OptiLight, radiofrequency, amniotic membranes, punctal plugs), myopia management, specialty and standard contact lenses, diabetic eye exams, glaucoma care, and an in-house optical lab that edges lenses on site for same-day service on many prescriptions.
customers: Affluent local adults and families buying designer frames, dry-eye and myopia patients, contact lens wearers, and patients using vision insurance.

size_signals.signal: In-house optical lab that edges and finishes lenses on site for many same-day orders
Doctor plus named staff (Dr. Silvana Abadeer OD and her team), one East Brunswick location at 545 NJ-18
Deep site: separate pages for 20+ conditions and services, a blog, insurance and 'concierge care' pages

website_review.primary_cta: 'BOOK NOW' (hero button) opening the ADIT booking portal in a new tab, plus a header 'Call or Text' number
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Yes - booking.adit.com portal with 'This Appointment is for' (Myself/Spouse/Child) and new-vs-existing patient steps; no CAPTCHA observed
website_review.trust_signals: Named doctor with photo, patient testimonials, photos of the lobby and practice, insurance page, 'optimal wellness / dry eye' expertise pages, blog
website_review.out_of_date_signs: On a 390 px phone the header block (social icons, address, 'Call or Text' number, Menu) fills roughly the top half of the screen before the logo, and a Vimeo background video shows burned-in screen text that collides with the headline so the hero reads as broken
website_review.search_basics: Strong: title and meta description name the eye doctor, service and East Brunswick, and conditions/services each have their own page with keyword-rich URLs; Optician JSON-LD is present, robots.txt blocks nothing important and names a sitemap index
top_issues: No contact form anywhere - booking is either the external ADIT portal or a phone call
Mobile header wastes the top half of the screen on address and social icons before the practice name or CTA
Hero background video renders with legible junk text behind the headline on mobile, undermining a premium brand
Structured data is a generic Optician node - no opening hours or service list, so agents cannot answer 'what are your hours' from schema

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: crawlable WordPress site, sitemap index, robots.txt allows all except a suggestion endpoint, strong 4.9/338 review profile. Answerable: excellent body copy - services, conditions, insurance and dry-eye treatments all written as text with dedicated URLs - and schema exists but only as an Optician node without hours. Bookable: real online booking through booking.adit.com with patient-type and new/existing steps and no CAPTCHA; there is no on-site form and no quote path.

operations_signals.signal: Booking runs through a third-party portal while the site also advertises 'Call or Text', so intake arrives in at least three channels - inference: staff reconcile them manually
In-house lens edging promises same-day service on many prescriptions - inference: lab order status questions land on the front desk
Site markets high-touch 'concierge care' and dry-eye treatment packages - inference: higher-ticket, consultation-led sales that reward fast follow-up

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add an on-site, agent-submittable contact/quote request form (frame or dry-eye consult, insurance question) alongside the ADIT booking so enquiries do not dead-end at a phone number
top_opportunities.evidence: No form exists on the home page or booking flow; only 'Call or Text' and the external portal

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the mobile hero and header: move address/social below the fold, make the video poster a clean still, and put BOOK NOW and the phone number in the first screen
top_opportunities.evidence: 390 px screenshot shows the header occupying ~half the viewport and video text bleeding through behind the headline

top_opportunities.opportunity: Extend schema beyond Optician: add openingHours, services, geo and price range so an AI agent can answer hours/location/insurance questions from structured data
top_opportunities.evidence: Only an Optician node with name, url, logo, image and description was found - no hours or address fields

scores.reasons: Gap: modest - the site is well structured, ranks for many conditions and books online; problems are presentation and plumbing rather than fundamentals. Pay: luxury eyewear, in-house lab and dry-eye treatment revenue at a Route 18 location, so high ticket values. Ease: form, hero and schema fixes are quick. Evidence: I loaded the pages, opened the ADIT booking flow and took the mobile screenshot myself, but Google listing numbers came from a directory, not Google.
